in_hebrew.name: Farmelo
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Soldier of the earth
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Farmelo הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Farmelo was a name given to warriors who protected and tended to the land. This name embodies the spirit of courage, loyalty, and faithfulness towards the natural world.

in_latin.name: Farmelus
in_latin.meaning: nomen a Graeco derivatum, significans agricola vel ruralis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Christianum a Graeco derivatum, significans agricola vel ruralis, originem habens in verbo 'φάρμακον', quod agros colere significat. In early Christian church, nomen huius generis saepe in honorem sanctitatis et devotionis Christi usitatum fuit. Farmelus, qui significare potest 'fidelis agricola', in traditione Christiana exemplum fidei et laboris agricolarum repraesentat. Nomen huius generis in cultura Christiana usitatum est, et multae personas in Ecclesia Christiana cum hoc nomine celebratae sunt.
